bio.text: Bob Fioretti is the Republican candidate for Illinois Attorney General in 2026, challenging Democratic incumbent Kwame Raoul.
He served as alderman of Chicago's 2nd Ward from 2007 to 2015 and trained as a civil rights attorney.
Since leaving the City Council he has run unsuccessfully for mayor (twice), Cook County state's attorney and Cook County Board president.

sources.title: What to know about the race for Illinois attorney general
